rule_questions: Phase 1/2 gene-therapy trials here all have safety-only (or safety + transgene-expression) primaries. Should efficacy then be untested (not_measured), or may a registered secondary disease endpoint stand in when no efficacy primary exists at all? I applied the strict rule to efficacy 5-8.

When a model predicted a harm in kind but placed it at a >5x higher dose and patients were not dose-limited by it (valanafusp hypoglycemia), is dose contra without blocked_by, and does count-once then remove the safety same entry?

Engagement 6/13 (azamidugene): blood IDUA rose in patients after allogeneic HSCT and laronidase long before 2010. Is the model's claim of supranormal levels from autologous cells a distinct, prospective prediction, or does any earlier blood-IDUA rise with IDUA replacement make it a retrodiction (as laronidase's GAG fall did for engagement 5)?

Safety 2: once count-once moves a predicted harm to dose, does the same track's remaining tolerability statement get scored in safety (here same, partial: IRR 1.7%, ADAs), or does the safety entry go untested?
